name: Kurone
source:
3rd year high school student.
Kurone is a 3rd year student, though it's unknown which class he belongs to. He's stoic and shrouded in mystery. Kurone is indifferent, with a philosophical outlook and is farsighted. As a result, he's not like an ordinary high school student. He excels in all disciplines of magic, particularly necromancy and spiritual studies.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.p-reve.com/goes/#!/chara]official website profile[/URL].]
